source_basis: The more mature a system is, the more benefit and the more advantage. Thus, worthy of attention.
interpretation: Two proportional gains are escalated into a reason to build the model.
applicability: Reusable wherever a paper must justify modelling something.
counterevidence: The gains have to be real consequences, not restatements.

source_basis: Aware of this, we establish a set of models to assist not only the client but also other firms.
interpretation: A motive is turned into a build decision and the audience is widened in the same sentence.
applicability: Reusable as an opening move for a commissioned model.
counterevidence: The wider audience must actually be served later in the paper.

source_basis: To begin with, we establish the assessment. Next, we integrate. Finally, we set up the extension.
interpretation: The method list is ordered with fixed openers so a reader can count the models.
applicability: Reusable for any paper that builds several models in sequence.
counterevidence: The order of the openers must match the order of the sections.

source_basis: We integrate two scores and decide in which level the system locates.
interpretation: A merge and a classification are kept in one sentence.
applicability: Reusable when a number must be turned into a placement on a scale.
counterevidence: The scale has to be defined before the sentence is used.

source_basis: Indeed, data support decisions. However, preserving data is hard, let alone using it.
interpretation: A concession is followed by an escalation to a harder task.
applicability: Reusable for raising the stakes in a background section.
counterevidence: The second task must genuinely be harder than the first.

source_basis: Consequently, a well-operated system is urgently needed for every corporation.
interpretation: The difficulty just stated is converted into a necessity.
applicability: Reusable as the sentence after a let-alone escalation.
counterevidence: Without the prior difficulty the urgency is unearned.

source_basis: We analyse and solve the problems step-by-step, and the flow diagram is shown for better arranging.
interpretation: The plan is promised as numbered steps and then delegated to a figure.
applicability: Reusable where a paper wants the overview in a diagram rather than in prose.
counterevidence: The figure must actually be the overview.

source_basis: We make the following assumptions, all of which are properly justified.
interpretation: The section commits in advance to a reason for every assumption.
applicability: Reusable as the opening line of an assumption section.
counterevidence: Every assumption below must carry its justification.

source_basis: Each bullet is an Assumption line followed by a Justification line.
interpretation: Claim and reason are kept visually separate instead of being folded together.
applicability: Reusable for any list of assumptions.
counterevidence: The justification must add a source, not repeat the claim.

source_basis: In order to comprehensively assess the level, we establish the model.
interpretation: The model is bound to its job in the first line of the section.
applicability: Reusable as a section opener.
counterevidence: The purpose must be the one the model actually serves.

source_basis: The weight will be more convincing by the integration of the two methods.
interpretation: A combination is defended on credibility rather than on accuracy.
applicability: Reusable when two methods are merged.
counterevidence: Both methods must contribute.

source_basis: It is widely acknowledged that indicators need to be SMART. We attach great importance to measurability while avoiding overlooking the rest.
interpretation: A borrowed standard is adopted and then weighted toward one part.
applicability: Reusable when a paper borrows a checklist.
counterevidence: The caveat about the other parts must be honoured.

source_basis: Thus, we take the rate as an indicator. It is defined as follows.
interpretation: The prose hands off to a formula in a fixed two-sentence shape.
applicability: Reusable wherever a definition is followed by an equation.
counterevidence: A formula must follow.

source_basis: Since the specifics are not given, the fuzzy model is taken into consideration.
interpretation: A softer model is motivated by absent data.
applicability: Reusable when a paper switches methods because inputs are missing.
counterevidence: The data must really be absent.

source_basis: The method is objective, based on the principle that the greater the dispersion, the greater the differentiation, and thus the more information.
interpretation: A weighting method is grounded in its principle before any formula appears.
applicability: Reusable before an entropy or variance weighting.
counterevidence: The formulas must implement the principle.

source_basis: Since the indicators are measurable, we attach greater significance to the entropy method, since it is more objective, and we set the coefficient.
interpretation: Objectivity is converted into a specific mixing weight.
applicability: Reusable when a paper must justify a convex combination.
counterevidence: The value of the coefficient must be stated.

source_basis: On one hand the components are equally important. Second, the method is quantified, which means it is more operable.
interpretation: Two numbered reasons defend one choice.
applicability: Reusable for defending a weighting.
counterevidence: The two reasons must support the same choice.

source_basis: To make full use of the data, we set the primary task to upgrade the maturity level.
interpretation: The goal is reduced to a single action before the optimization.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of an optimization section.
counterevidence: There must be only one primary task.

source_basis: The task is translated as finding a vector such that the sum reaches the surface.
interpretation: A verbal goal is restated as a geometric condition.
applicability: Reusable when an optimization is also drawn.
counterevidence: The condition must be the one optimized.

source_basis: To summarize, our task is to find the vector of least difficulty while the end lies on the surface.
interpretation: Objective and constraint are compressed into one sentence.
applicability: Reusable as the closing line of an optimization setup.
counterevidence: Both the objective and the constraint must be present.

source_basis: Thus, the choice depends on urgency.
interpretation: A comparison is collapsed into a single deciding factor.
applicability: Reusable after weighing two options.
counterevidence: The factor must have been compared.

source_basis: Efficiency should be taken priority over the other indicators.
interpretation: Computed weights are turned into a stated ranking.
applicability: Reusable when a paper converts numbers into advice.
counterevidence: The ranking must agree with the weights.

source_basis: In a word, data quality is essential.
interpretation: A list of dimensions is closed with one verdict.
applicability: Reusable at the end of an enumeration.
counterevidence: The enumeration must come first.

source_basis: Once the indicators are calculated, the level can be determined, and effectiveness can thus be evaluated.
interpretation: Three links are chained in one sentence.
applicability: Reusable for a measurement protocol.
counterevidence: No link may be skipped.

source_basis: The concept of economies of scale enlightens us.
interpretation: An imported idea is credited as the spark for the extension.
applicability: Reusable when a paper borrows from another field.
counterevidence: The borrowed content must be accurate.

source_basis: The data comes from the ministry, so all the data is precise and accurate.
interpretation: Accuracy is inferred from provenance.
applicability: Reusable when a paper must defend its data.
counterevidence: The source must be official.

source_basis: The curves take the same value at one point, demonstrating that the assumption is reasonable when the scale is a certain value.
interpretation: A graph feature is read as local support for an assumption.
applicability: Reusable for interpreting a crossing or an intersection.
counterevidence: The condition must be kept; the support is local.

source_basis: The model is practicable for other industries. However, there are slightly some differences that need pointing out.
interpretation: A transfer claim is qualified in the very next sentence.
applicability: Reusable when a model is carried to a new setting.
counterevidence: The differences must then be listed.

source_basis: The coefficients of determination are 0.9758 and 0.9731, which suggest strong correlativity.
interpretation: A fit statistic and its reading share one sentence.
applicability: Reusable in a reliability section.
counterevidence: The values must be the computed ones, and a fit is not causation.

source_basis: We integrate both aspects, which means the weights are more reasonable.
interpretation: A design choice is cashed as a benefit.
applicability: Reusable in a strengths section.
counterevidence: The benefit must follow from the choice.

source_basis: Optimization within a level could not be done in this model.
interpretation: A limit is stated as something the model refuses to do.
applicability: Reusable in a weaknesses section.
counterevidence: The exclusion must be accurate.

source_basis: The corporation commissioned us to develop a model to measure maturity and provide strategies.
interpretation: The letter locates the work as commissioned.
applicability: Reusable for the opening of a letter to a client.
counterevidence: The commission must be real.

source_basis: Do not lack confidence if the outcome is not the top level. If this were the case, the company would optimize as soon as possible.
interpretation: A disappointing result is pre-empted and a remedy promised.
applicability: Reusable in a letter that reports a score.
counterevidence: The remedy must be the model just described.

source_basis: Our team have every reason to believe the system is capable. Please do not hesitate to cooperate.
interpretation: The letter ends on assurance plus an invitation.
applicability: Reusable as a letter closing.
counterevidence: The claim must be one the model supports.

source_basis: Nine of the twelve indicators are written as closed formulas scaled so that one is best.
interpretation: The assessment rests on explicit formulas rather than on verbal scales.
applicability: The formula-per-indicator pattern transfers to other maturity models.
counterevidence: Three indicators are only borrowed and normalized, so the coverage is not complete.

source_basis: The fuzzy score is the product of a weight vector and a three-by-five grade matrix.
interpretation: Expert judgement enters through membership grades rather than through point scores.
applicability: Reusable where inputs are grades instead of measurements.
counterevidence: The grades themselves are never shown.

source_basis: Entropy weights and hierarchy weights are combined with a fixed one-fifth share on the hierarchy side.
interpretation: The paper commits to a number for the subjective share instead of leaving the mix verbal.
applicability: The fixed-share mix transfers to any objective-plus-subjective weighting.
counterevidence: The share is chosen, not estimated.

source_basis: The final score is four fifths of the weighted score plus one fifth of the fuzzy score.
interpretation: The same four-fifths ratio is reused at the top level.
applicability: Reusable as a two-level weighting scheme.
counterevidence: Nothing shows the ratio is robust.

source_basis: The upgrade minimizes the difficulty of a step whose average lands on 0.8.
interpretation: Reaching the next band is written as a linear program.
applicability: The surface-and-step framing transfers to other staged maturity models.
counterevidence: The program is never solved.

source_basis: Component demand is a fitted function of firm size, rescaled and renormalized into weights.
interpretation: Size enters the model only through the weights, not through the indicators.
applicability: Reusable when a model must travel across organizations of different size.
counterevidence: Only two of the three components get a fitted curve.

source_basis: The minimum-difficulty step is a linear program in three variables with one equality.
interpretation: The problem is small enough to solve by hand, so the omission is not computational.
applicability: Flags a gap a later paper could close.
counterevidence: The difficulty vector would still have to be supplied.

source_basis: The four assumptions each name the source of the belief: official data, indistinguishable experts, the client's own collection, the Pareto principle.
interpretation: No assumption is left as a bare assertion.
applicability: The paired format transfers directly.
counterevidence: Two of the justifications restate the assumption instead of adding evidence.

source_basis: The paper narrows the whole optimization to reaching the top band and says so.
interpretation: The reduced scope is declared rather than hidden.
applicability: Reusable when a paper optimizes only one transition.
counterevidence: The other transitions are then simply absent.

source_basis: The recommendations are addressed to three named departments, each with its own subsection.
interpretation: Advice is routed to the stakeholder who would act on it.
applicability: Reusable for a model with several audiences.
counterevidence: The advice is qualitative even though the model is numeric.

source_basis: The transfer to trucking is given as a numbered sequence of steps.
interpretation: An extension is made into a procedure rather than a claim.
applicability: Reusable when a model is carried to a new industry.
counterevidence: The steps are sketched, not run.

source_basis: Figure 2 shows the integrated weights as three donut charts.
interpretation: The reader sees which indicator dominates each component without reading the vectors.
applicability: A per-component weight chart transfers to any grouped weighting.
counterevidence: The chart hides that the vectors do not sum to one.

source_basis: Figure 3 draws the current vector, the step and the difficulty direction against the target plane.
interpretation: The whole optimization is readable from one picture.
applicability: The cube-and-plane drawing transfers to any low-dimensional target.
counterevidence: The picture cannot show the optimal step, because none was computed.

source_basis: Figure 9 plots both fitted curves and marks their crossing.
interpretation: The single point where the equal-weight assumption holds is visible.
applicability: Reusable for showing where two fitted relations agree.
counterevidence: The fit statistics are not on the figure.

source_basis: The crossing point is offered as evidence that equal weights are reasonable at one scale.
interpretation: An assumption is checked against data rather than only justified in prose.
applicability: A crossing test transfers to other rescalings.
counterevidence: The check holds at one point only.

source_basis: Both quadratic fits are reported with coefficients of determination above 0.97.
interpretation: The reliability section uses a number rather than an adjective alone.
applicability: Reusable as a minimum standard for a fitted extension.
counterevidence: A high fit does not validate the maturity score itself.

source_basis: The berth counts come from the Ministry of Transport.
interpretation: The one external dataset has a named official source.
applicability: Reusable as a provenance standard.
counterevidence: No other dataset is identified.

source_basis: The entropy formula divides by the logarithm of the number of objects.
interpretation: The weighting implies a panel of objects.
applicability: Records that an entropy weight needs more than one object.
counterevidence: The objects are never named.

source_basis: Experts are assumed equally professional.
interpretation: The hierarchy weights treat every expert as one row.
applicability: The assumption is needed by any unweighted expert panel.
counterevidence: No check on expert disagreement is offered.

source_basis: Reaching the optimizing band is treated as the only improvement worth modelling.
interpretation: The objective function inherits this restriction.
applicability: Bounded to staged maturity models.
counterevidence: The paper later concedes the restriction is a weakness.

source_basis: Six weight vectors are printed, three from entropy and three from the hierarchy.
interpretation: The weighting is carried through to numbers.
applicability: The vectors can be reused as a worked example.
counterevidence: They are not all normalized.

source_basis: People weights fall out near a third each; data quality takes the largest share of the process component.
interpretation: The donut chart and the vectors agree on which indicator dominates.
applicability: The dominance pattern is the actionable result.
counterevidence: No system is scored, so the dominance is of weights, not of outcomes.

source_basis: The curves cross at berth count 1000.8 with value 0.9627.
interpretation: The scale where the components balance is reported as a point, not a range.
applicability: Reusable as a calibration point for seaports.
counterevidence: The point depends on the two fitted quadratics.

source_basis: Working efficiency keeps only the worse of the two relative overruns.
interpretation: The better skill cannot raise the score at all.
applicability: A warning for any min-of-penalties construction.
counterevidence: The prose never explains the choice.

source_basis: Cost accuracy subtracts a signed relative error, unlike schedule accuracy which uses an absolute value.
interpretation: The indicator can exceed one or turn negative, breaking the shared scale.
applicability: A warning for inconsistent normalization across indicators.
counterevidence: No worked value shows the damage.

source_basis: The Defined band and the Managed band are both written as starting at 0.4.
interpretation: A score can fall in two levels at once.
applicability: A warning for hand-built ordinal scales.
counterevidence: The bands may be a transcription slip, but both are printed.

source_basis: The second hierarchy vector sums to about 0.99 and the third entropy vector sums to just over one.
interpretation: Weights that should be shares do not sum to one.
applicability: A warning for reported weight vectors.
counterevidence: The discrepancy is small and could be rounding.

source_basis: The process efficiency indicator is called DPC, then DPE, then DC.
interpretation: One indicator carries three names.
applicability: Records a naming collision for anyone reimplementing the model.
counterevidence: The formula itself is unambiguous.
